g.title: stm32_usb_cdc_flow
g.text: AERIS-10 - STM32 USB CDC communication flow (host GUI <-> STM32F746) with the receive-path defects
Drawing ID: SD-04 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: PARTIAL - usbd_cdc_if.c / USB Device Library are missing from the repository; RX callback binding is a documented defect

Source: CODE/main.cpp:128-132, 331-338, 1527-1555, 1692; LIB/USBHandler.cpp:1-93, USBHandler.h; LIB/RadarSettings.h:12; LIB/gps_handler.cpp:65-119; 9_Firmware/9_3_GUI/GUI_V5.py:307-477; docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md 3.5, STM-T04 (C4, C5, C6)

g.title: cluster_host
g.text: HOST PC - GUI_V5.py class STM32USBInterface (:307-477), pyusb bulk endpoints (:358-399)

g.title: cluster_mw
g.text: STM32 USB DEVICE MIDDLEWARE - MISSING from repository (CubeMX-generated + ST library)

g.title: h_open
g.text: usb.core / usb.util: claims interface, finds OUT/IN bulk endpoints (:379-386)
(platform caveat: OS CDC driver normally owns the device - docs/GUI/DEPENDENCIES.md section 4)

g.title: h_send
g.text: -> start flag goes out as 4 bytes + 60

g.text: STM32 PA11 DM / PA12 DP -> mini-USB
the only host data link present in the

g.title: mw_conf
g.text: hpcd_USB_OTG_FS (extern in LIB/stm32f7xx_it.c:58), HAL_PCD_MspInit, NVIC OTG_FS_IRQn

g.title: mw_if
g.text: USBD_Interface_fops_FS binds the file's OWN static int8_t CDC_Receive_FS(uint8_t*, uint32_t*)
(standard CubeMX template; the generated file is not in the repo)

g.title: fw_cb
g.text: DEFECT C4: nothing in the repository

g.title: fw_flag
g.text: searches START_FLAG {23,46,158,237} (:38); on match: state=RECEIVING_SETTINGS, buffer_index=0 (:43-45)
then FORWARDS any remaining bytes to processSettingsData (:51-52)
DEFECT C5: the 60 padding zeros from the GUI land at buffer offset 0

g.title: fw_wait
g.text: main.cpp:1534-1555 do { if (isStartFlagReceived() && getState()==READY_FOR_DATA) { settings = getSettings(); /* getters commented out :1540-1550 */ } } while (!isStartFlagReceived());
with C4 the loop never exits; even if bound, C5 blocks READY_FOR_DATA; settings are never applied to the radar

g.title: cfg
g.text: device configuration consumers (intended, NOT connected in code)
RadarSettings getters: system_frequency, chirp_duration_1/2, chirps_per_position, freq_min/max, prf1/2, max_distance, map_size (RadarSettings.h:15-24)
no call site applies them to ADF4382 / ADAR1000 / FPGA (main.cpp:1540-1550 commented out)

g.title: legend
g.text: blue = code present in repository; orange = present with a documented defect (C4/C5/C6 per docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md STM-T04);
red dashed = file/library absent from repository; grey dotted = intended but not implemented
Packet formats (verified in source): start flag 4 B = [23,46,158,237] (GUI_V5.py:403 <-> USBHandler.cpp:38);
settings 82 B big-endian 'SET'+3x double+uint32+6x double+'END' (GUI_V5.py:454-468 <-> RadarSettings.h:12, USBHandler.cpp:68-75)
Line-number verification for the RX-callback defect done on 2026-10-09: main.cpp:331 'void CDC_Receive_FS(uint8_t* Buf, uint32_t *Len) {' inside extern "C" block :328-339;
grep for 'CDC_Receive_FS' across 9_Firmware/ finds only this definition (no caller, no fops table)
NOT VERIFIED on hardware: enumeration, actual byte flow, timeout behaviour
